blocks.text:
To activate a 3D space, the element needs perspective. The perspective defines the distance between the user's viewpoint and the
object.

A low value, like perspective: 200px;,
assumes that the user is close to the object and creates a strong 3D effect.

A high value, like perspective: 2000px;,
assumes that the user is far away from the object and creates a mild 3D effect.
Without perspective, any 3D transforms will look flat and two-dimensional.
A perspective can be added in two ways:

The perspective property is always set on the parent element,
and each child will share the same 3D space.
